integrity: Analytical proof presented, independent same-order finite exact Gram checks and boundary comparisons supplied. No external audit or independent mathematical validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite tree graphical zonotopes only; intrinsic Euclidean surface measures. The facet-area expression follows from standard incidence-Gram minor geometry; the assessed mathematical contribution is sharp uniqueness for both first and second extrema, equality of their first positive gaps, and asymptotic size contrast. Novelty could be affected by undiscovered vertex-split functional equivalents.
title: Sharp second-extremal Euclidean surface areas of tree graphical zonotopes
